methods.php_tokens: PHP 8 token_get_all(TOKEN_PARSE); ignore only whitespace/comments; preserve literal strings, HTML and operator tokens.
methods.similarity: SequenceMatcher matching-token ratio with autojunk disabled; domain words normalized in identifiers/literals, all other literals preserved. Screening only; not percentage of safely removable code. JS tokenization is lexical, not an AST.
methods.metrics: PHP-only formatting-neutral tokens/declarations/decision operators and 16-token windows. Semicolons include for headers; ternaries are candidates after nullable-type filtering. Function lengths are physical spans including closures.
methods.file_exclusions: Same source_inventory definition: public/backend/db only; exclude vendor, local.php, .DS_Store and .gitkeep. Excludes tests, docs, runtime, storage, logs and Git. First-party artwork counts as files/bytes but not code bytes.
